summary: AllBytesIter incorrectly yields an extra zero after 255 because its inclusive bound allows 256, which casts to zero as u8. The fix uses an exclusive bound, yielding exactly bytes 0 through 255. The test added by the fix checks that each byte equals its enumeration index and should fail at index 256 after reversal. Reproduction has not been run.
expected_failure: assertion failed: AllBytesIter::new().enumerate().all(|(i, b)| b as usize == i)
